SK-02.c01: The basic control skills test is the **second** skills test, a set of exercises marked with **boundary lines and cones**.
An **encroachment** is touching or crossing a boundary line or cone with any part of your vehicle.
A **pull-up** is stopping and driving forward to fix a position; a **look** is leaving your seat, opening the door, or walking back on a bus.
**Sight-side** is the driver's (left) side, so backing toward it lets you watch the rear out your window.
You must pass the vehicle inspection test before taking this one.
SK-02.c02: **No interpreters**: the test is in English; 2 verbal warnings, and the **3rd** language offense on the same date is automatic failure.
**Backup cameras and self-parking** cannot be the only thing you use, because the test measures **your** judgment.
You are tested on a **subset of 6** exercises: straight line backing, offset back right and left, two parallel parks, and alley dock.
**Refusing** an exercise or not finishing it as told may be an **automatic failure**; you get **3 attempts** in total for all skills tests.
SK-02.c03: The examiner scores **4 things**: encroachments, pull-ups, looks and final position.
Each time any part of the vehicle touches or crosses a line or cone counts as **one error**.
A pull-up is stopping **and driving forward**; just stopping without changing direction is **not** a pull-up.
**Initial pull-ups** are not penalized, but **too many** count as errors.
SK-02.c04: Before getting out for a look, put the vehicle in **Neutral** and **set the parking brake(s)**.
Get out **facing the vehicle** with **3 points of contact**; on a bus, keep a firm hold on the handrail.
Not securing the vehicle or not getting out safely **may be an automatic failure**, since it can roll or you can get hurt.
You get at most **2 looks** per exercise, but only **1** on straight line backing; opening the door counts as a look.
SK-02.c05: Finish **every** exercise exactly in the **final position** the examiner described.
Missing the final position means you are **penalized** and **could fail** the test, because "almost parked" is not parked.
SK-02.c06: Back straight down a lane marked by **2 rows of cones** without touching or crossing its edges.
Only **1 look** is allowed on straight line backing.
SK-02.c07: **Offset back/right** uses a space at your right rear; **offset back/left** uses a space at your left rear.
Drive forward toward the outer boundary, then back into the neighboring lane until the **front is past the first set of cones**.
Back **slowly** and turn toward the **driver's side** when you can, since backing toward the right is harder to see.
SK-02.c08: **Driver side** parallel parking uses a space on your **left**; **conventional** uses a space on your **right**.
Drive past the space's entrance, parallel to it, then back in without crossing the front, side or rear boundaries.
You are finished only when your **entire vehicle** is **completely inside** the space.
SK-02.c09: In the alley dock you **sight-side back** into a lane at a right angle, starting parallel to the outer boundary.
Finish with the rear **within 3 feet** of the back of the alley and the vehicle **straight**, touching no lines or cones.
Stopping **5 feet** from the back, or 2 feet away but angled, is **not finished**.
SK-02.c10: Look at your path before starting and check the **mirrors on both sides** often.
Back **slowly** in the **lowest reverse gear** so you can fix steering mistakes and stop quickly.
With a trailer, turn the wheel the **opposite** way from where you want the trailer to go, and correct drift right away.
**Pull forward** (a pull-up) to reposition when needed.
